items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: So DeJohnette comes to school. And one of the students goes, “Mr. DeJohnette, did you practice with records when you were a kid?”

ctx.x: Yeah, and all the drummers my age — DeJohnette came to school a number of years and I was always preaching to my students, I’m saying, “I hate to clue you in on this but you’re spending thousands of dollars to do what I did at home for nothing.” And so I’m telling — I’d say, “Play along with anything.” “Well there’s drums on there.” “Well good, that’ll keep you honest, you know? It doesn’t get in the way. All it does is show up what you need to work on.” So DeJohnette comes to school. And one of the students…
